label: D1 after an a1 choice that rarely led to S2 (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and on dev 100% of active steps with known history have prev_action == a1 and prev_common == rare (i.e. the previous trial went a1 -> S2 rare); it never fires after a common transition or after an a2 choice. It also only fires in episode trials < ~70 (none after trial 75), so the agent appears to track elapsed time. Fires after both rewarded and unrewarded rare trials (prev_reward 0 has a higher rate), and the upcoming choice is almost always a1 (99% of mass), i.e. the agent is staying with a1; adding action == 1 raises dev F1 only slightly (0.52 -> 0.56), so I recorded the predicate using only observed variables. Dev: precision 0.38, recall 0.84, mass recall 0.85. The misses are mostly rel -3 D1 steps where the previous trial is outside the window, so they cannot be checked. Precision is limited: only about 40% of qualifying steps fire, and neither prev_reward, the good state, policy logit, nor two-trial-back history separates them cleanly (best: the trial before was a common a1, precision 0.50). Activation magnitude is roughly uniform (median 0.165); I did not find what modulates it.
